notes: All equipment stages, material amounts, Ely costs, dungeon yields and point bonuses are copied from the wiki calculator data.
The data follows the Korean wiki and is not adjusted to Global server progression.
English labels are translations; Korean source labels are preserved.
Expected clears use the slowest material in each dungeon. Expected days assume one clear per dungeon per day, in parallel.
Point reward chests are opt-in. Transcendence and combination selections force difficulty 5, including completed selections, matching the wiki.
